paper_identity.title: Unmasking the nuclear matter equation of state

cross_mass_significance: Establishes the emergence of a soft isoscalar monopole breathing mode at Ex ~ 8-10 MeV in exotic neutron-rich nuclei (132Sn -> 140Sn) driven by the radial oscillation of the neutron skin against the core; proves that applying the standard leptodermous liquid-drop expansion of K_A to neutron-rich isotopes without separating the soft skin mode introduces a severe artificial divergence in the extracted symmetry incompressibility K_tau (distorting K_tau from -500 to -800 MeV).
